title: The Farthest Whisper
narration: Somewhere out there, a spacecraft is still talking. Voyager 1. It's flown farther than anything we've ever made.
visual_goal: A tiny spacecraft against vast stars, with a faint signal wave emanating.

title: Launch and Legacy
narration: Launched in 1977, it weighed 815 kilograms. Its mission? Five years. It's been forty-nine.
visual_goal: Historical footage of Titan IIIE Centaur launch, then transition to modern animation of Voyager trajectory.

title: The Journey Out
narration: It flew past Jupiter, saw volcanoes on Io. Then Saturn. And kept going. In 2012, it crossed into interstellar space.
visual_goal: Animated flyby of Jupiter and Saturn, followed by a transition to the heliopause boundary with a cross-over effect.

title: Pale Blue Dot
narration: In 1990, it turned back and captured Earth. A pale blue dot. Six billion kilometers away. Everything we've ever known, in one pixel.
visual_goal: Show the famous Pale Blue Dot photo, slowly zooming out to a wide shot of Voyager far away.

title: The Carries On
narration: Now it's over 165 astronomical units away. Still speeding at 17 kilometers per second. It carries our sounds, our images, our greeting. But the real message? We are curious. We explore. And we never stop.
visual_goal: Close-up of the Golden Record, then a slow zoom to Voyager flying into the dark, with stars streaking by.
